requirements.evidence: Author argument/directory/missing-file/import tests; independent exact 8 MiB successful API+CLI equality, +1 byte rejection, byte-vs-character bound, malformed UTF-8 variants, retained BOM rejected as invalid JSON, JSON text with arbitrary extension, non-JSON JS rejected, extra argument rejected. Bounded read verified statically.

requirements.requirement: No provider/network/storage action, credentials read, or product/frozen asset mutation.
requirements.evidence: Collector imports no provider client and has no environment/credential read or file/DB write path. Only read-only source hashes, input read, and stdout/stderr are used; D1 import supplies the error class only. Fresh reviewer runs report 0 non-loopback denials. Protected app/worker/materials-quality-v2 diff versus baseline is empty. This is bounded source/run evidence, not full runtime attestation.

groups.name: multi-item projection preserves native order, filtering, normalization, hints and raw candidate copies
empty lists and fully filtered labels never create null terms or inferred item groups
explicit intent changes only the native constraint mapping stimulus
source span offsets are native, and only labels supported by the quoted span survive
owner mismatch, revoked fixtures, missing or ambiguous quotes produce native rejection only
malformed canonical candidates retain raw JSON and are not repaired or treated as outer errors
strict wrapper/reference/segment boundaries reject supplied policy, catalog, mapping or answer overrides
intent membership is checked without requiring valid candidate adoption semantics
all 512 scenarios and 1000 unique source segments remain within the bounded outer contract
determinism includes exact input bytes, lexical scenario canonicalization, array order and all metadata keys
overflowing JSON numeric literals are rejected instead of silently becoming null
unexpected native Zod exception aborts the collection and CLI emits no partial report
deep malformed extraction JSON is preserved without recursive API or CLI serialization failure
exact 8 MiB API and CLI input succeeds, while one extra byte is rejected
CLI fatal decoding rejects overlong, truncated, surrogate and out-of-range UTF-8 sequences
CLI reads JSON text only and never executes a caller file or accepts an extra output argument
reviewed files remain unchanged during independent probes
